mines.mine_notes: Historic silver-lead-zinc mine in the Silver Valley, Idaho (100%); restart of the upper/mid-level zones. Produced 165 Moz Ag and 5 Mt base metals 1885-1981 (closed 1981; 45+ years idle). No production in 2025; first concentrate shipment to Teck's Trail Smelter from the newly commissioned 1,800 tpd plant reported in 2026; full commercial production targeted end 2026. MSHA re-categorized the mine 'Active: Producing' Dec 3, 2025. ~20,000 tons of ore stockpiled underground for commissioning. Metallurgical recoveries: Ag 89%, Pb 87%, Zn 92%. Royalty/stream obligations reduced from 11.85% to 5% in 2025 restructuring; US$68M secured to fund milestones; ~$39% debt reduction. Silver Loan (Monetary Metals): 1.2 Moz Ag principal tranches advanced in 2024-2025, 15% interest. No current reserves or resources disclosed in the 10-K.
mines.processing: 1,800 tpd processing plant (commissioning 2026); tailings filter press
